findings.title: Broken Object Level Authorization
findings.evidence: user-a@example.test requested /orders/1002 (owned by user-b@example.test) and received HTTP 200 with the same object User B received.
findings.expected_result: HTTP 403 or HTTP 404 for another user's object.
findings.remediation: Verify object ownership before returning order details.

findings.title: Excessive Data Exposure
findings.evidence: The response included sensitive field(s): internal_notes, payment_reference
findings.expected_result: A normal user response should omit internal or secret fields.
findings.actual_result: Sensitive fields were returned in the API response.
findings.remediation: Return an allowlisted response DTO for this endpoint and exclude internal notes, payment references, tokens, and secrets.

tested_endpoints.reason: The requesting user received the same object returned to its owner.
